method: Primary HTML fetched from official Adilet with urllib, parsed as text and relevant provisions read; web extraction of the current portal required JavaScript. English Adilet pages identify their translations as unofficial. OECD primary Recommendation PDF opened and read.

sources.instrument: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan of 21 May 2013 No. 94-V, On Personal Data and their Protection
sources.scope: Benchmark for a hypothetical Kazakhstan operator processing actual identifiable applicants; fictional profiles do not establish real consent or real personal-data processing compliance.

sources.scope: Kazakhstan AI operator assumed for design; no claim this classroom prototype is certified or has a settled statutory risk classification.
